observations: Photo 0 shows a cargo tricycle (motorized three-wheeler with rear cargo box), maroon/dark red body.
Front view: single headlight, double red-coil front shock absorbers, handlebar, front fender, spoked front wheel with visible tire wear.
Rear cargo bed/box visible behind the seat, metal construction, door/tailgate mechanism visible.
Seat backrest has a printed logo reading 'ROYAL MOTORCYCLE' with a crown icon.
Vehicle is parked on bare ground/dirt surrounded by scattered trash and debris.
No engine, undercarriage, odometer, chassis plate, or registration documents visible.
Only one angle (front-left) provided; no side, rear, or interior cargo-bed shots.

claims.claim: This vehicle is just 6 months used
claims.evidence: No odometer, purchase receipt, or registration date visible in photo 0; claim rests solely on seller's words.

risks.risk: Actual age/usage could be far more than 6 months, affecting engine wear and resale value.
risks.proof: Photo or clip of odometer/dashboard reading plus purchase receipt or registration papers.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/older age, not as lightly used

risks.risk: Engine and drivetrain condition unknown (no start-up sound, no exhaust smoke check).
risks.proof: Video clip of engine starting and idling, plus a short test drive.

risks.risk: Tire tread and front suspension (shocks) wear not clearly assessable from this single angle.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all three tires and shock absorbers.

risks.risk: Cargo box/body may have hidden rust, dents, or structural repair not visible from front.
risks.proof: Full side and rear photos of the cargo bed and chassis.

risks.risk: No registration/ownership documents shown; could indicate incomplete paperwork or disputed ownership.
risks.proof: Photo of vehicle registration/particulars and proof of ownership.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the odometer/dashboard display.
Video of the engine starting and running, including exhaust check.
Full side view and rear view of the cargo box and chassis.
Close-up of all three tires and suspension components.
Photo of registration papers or proof of ownership.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a cargo tricycle with a readable seat brand, but the seller's usage claim is unverifiable and key condition details (engine, tires, documents) are unseen, so it must be priced at worst-case condition pending further proof.
